name: Mistral API
summary: Direct Mistral API with Free mode, plan-included monthly usage and separately enabled prepaid PAYG overflow.

credentials.label: Mistral API key
credentials.help: Use your own Mistral Studio workspace API key; API availability and plan usage must be checked in the account.

setupSteps.title: Open Mistral Studio
setupSteps.description: Use an existing account and create your own API key manually. Free mode is enabled without a credit card, within usage/rate limits.

setupSteps.title: Check the organization plan
setupSteps.description: Review shared monthly included usage across API, Studio and Vibe Code; verify whether prepaid PAYG overflow is enabled.

setupSteps.title: Check model and workspace limits
setupSteps.description: Verify Small 4 availability, model TPM/RPS and workspace spending caps. Do not treat workspace caps as independent credit pools.

setupSteps.title: Add the direct route
setupSteps.description: Use https://api.mistral.ai/v1 and the pinned mistral-small-2603 model. Ordinary API keys do not imply Enterprise Admin API quota access.
